proposal.utterance: Classify 'the 2026 trial of X vs. Y'.

entities.label: 2026TrialOfXVsY
entities.rationale: A specific trial is a particular legal proceeding that unfolds in time — paradigmatically a Process (BFO_0000015). It is a named, singular happening, so it is an individual, not a class.

entities.label: Trial
entities.rationale: The kind 'Trial' is a common noun denoting a type of legal process. It is a class subsuming individual trial processes. No existing working class covers this kind, so a new class is minted.

entities.label: Year2026
entities.rationale: The year 2026 is a specific temporal region (a one-dimensional temporal region, BFO_0000038, subclass of BFO_0000008) during which the trial occurs. Naming the year asserts a temporal commitment.

relations.rationale: The individual trial is a member of the Trial class.
Trial is a subclass of Process (BFO_0000015).

The trial process occurs during (BFO_0000132 occurrent part of / temporal containment) the year 2026. If BFO_0000132 is not available, BFO_0000050 (part of) restricted to temporal regions is the fallback.

open_questions: Who are X and Y? If they are specific persons or entities, they should be minted as individuals (likely Material Entity / BFO_0000040) and linked to the trial via RO_0000057 (has participant).
What roles do X and Y bear in this trial (e.g., plaintiff, defendant)? Each role would be a Role individual (BFO_0000023) inhering in the respective participant.
Is there a specific court or jurisdiction in which this trial takes place? If so, a Site (BFO_0000029) individual should be added.
Should 'Trial' be further subclassed (e.g., CivilTrial, CriminalTrial) to capture the nature of 'X vs. Y' style adversarial proceedings?
Is the year 2026 the year the trial is initiated, concluded, or does it span the entire year? This affects how the temporal region relation is typed.
proposal.rationale_summary: The utterance names a specific legal proceeding ('the 2026 trial of X vs. Y'), which is paradigmatically a BFO Process (BFO_0000015) — a particular temporal happening with participants. As a proper-name individual, it is minted as working:2026TrialOfXVsY typed under the new class working:Trial (itself a subclass of BFO_0000015). The year '2026' commits the graph to a specific temporal region individual (BFO_0000038). No existing working class or individual covers a Trial process kind or this specific temporal region, so both are minted as new. The parties X and Y and any court or jurisdiction are left as open questions because the utterance does not name them specifically enough to assert individuals without risking misidentification.
